observations: Photo 0 shows a blue/black mountain bike with front suspension fork, front disc brake visible, and a rear derailleur/gear system.
Rim/tyre condition looks used but not clearly damaged in the single photo.
Brand/model text on the frame appears present but is not fully readable at this resolution.
No clear close-up of gear shifters, brake rotors, chain condition, or frame size/serial.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 clearly shows front suspension, but rear suspension (true dual shock) is not clearly visible in this single wide shot; tyre size/26" is not readable.
Aesthetic/frame quality is subjective and not verifiable from this single photo.
Tyres look intact in photo 0, but tread depth, sidewall cracks, and puncture history can’t be confirmed.
Photo 0 shows gear/brake hardware, but no proof of shifting/braking performance.
No specific adjustable parts (seat height, handlebar, suspension settings) are shown clearly.

risks.risk: Not actually dual-suspension (could be front suspension only).
risks.proof: Ask for a side/rear close-up showing the rear shock/hinge area (or a video panning from left side to rear).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not dual-shock (front suspension only).

risks.risk: Tyre wear/hidden punctures or dry-rot not visible in one photo.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up of both tyres (tread + sidewalls) and a short clip of the bike rolling over a flat surface.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used tyres needing possible replacement soon.

risks.risk: Gears may not shift correctly (bent derailleur, worn cassette/chain) and brakes may be weak or noisy.
risks.proof: Ask for a video: shift through all gears while pedaling + brake test showing stopping power (front and rear).
risks.if_unproven: Price as gears/brakes not guaranteed (assume service may be needed).

risks.risk: Frame size and exact wheel size (26") not confirmed; could be different size.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the size marking on the frame and a tape-measure shot of wheel diameter or tyre size marking.
risks.if_unproven: Price as uncertain size (worst-case mismatch for buyer fit).

proof_requests: Video of shifting through all gears while pedaling (front + rear derailleur) and a separate brake test clip (front and rear).
Close-up photos of the rear suspension area to confirm whether it is truly dual shock.
Close-up photos of tyre tread and sidewalls (both tyres) and chain/cassette condition.
Photo showing frame size marking and tyre size marking (to confirm 26").
response.reason: From the single photo, the bike appears to be an MTB with front suspension and disc brake, but key pricing drivers (true dual shock, wheel size, and whether gears/brakes work well) are not provable remotely without functional clips and close-ups.
